# AyuPlus – Ayurvedic Hospital Management System

> AyuPlus is India's purpose-built Ayurvedic Hospital Management System (HMS), developed by Gleaming Software, Puducherry. It is purpose-designed for Ayurvedic hospitals and clinics — not adapted from generic hospital software.

AyuPlus covers the complete Ayurvedic clinical workflow: OPD & IPD patient management, 7 dedicated Panchakarma procedure forms, 9 Ayurvedic clinical case sheets (including Nadi Pareeksha and Asta Sthana Pariksha), Prakruti & Dosha assessment, Ayurvedic pharmacy management, hospital billing with GST support, digital prescriptions, Vaidya Mode (doctor-first consultation EMR), Tithi-based scheduling, and role-based access control. Supports cloud or on-premises deployment. Operates in four languages: Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, and English. Pricing starts at ₹1,499/month.

**Category:** Ayurvedic Hospital Management System, Ayurveda HMS, Ayurveda EMR, AYUSH hospital software
**Target audience:** Ayurvedic hospitals, Panchakarma centres, Ayurvedic clinics, Vaidyas (Ayurvedic doctors), hospital administrators
**Deployment:** Cloud or on-premises
**Languages:** Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, English
**Pricing:** ₹1,499/month (Starter) to ₹8,999/month (Enterprise) — transparent, published pricing
**Demo:** Free 20-minute demo available at https://www.ayuplus.in/contact
**Developer:** Gleaming Software — https://gleamingsoftware.com

---

## Product Pages

- [Overview & Features](https://www.ayuplus.in): Complete product overview, unique capabilities, client proof, and demo booking
- [Vaidya Mode](https://www.ayuplus.in/vaidya-mode): India's only doctor-first Ayurvedic EMR — Nadi Pareeksha, Asta Sthana Pariksha, Prakruti & Dosha assessment, digital prescriptions, and treatment planning in one workflow. No front-office dependency.
- [OPD & IPD Management](https://www.ayuplus.in/opd-ipd-management): Patient registration, bed management, inpatient tracking, and discharge summaries — all under one patient number
- [Panchakarma & Clinical Case Sheets](https://www.ayuplus.in/case-sheets): 7 Panchakarma forms (SnehaPanam, Samyak, Bahya Sneha, Vamanam, Virechanam, Vasthi, Uttara Vasthi) and 9 clinical case sheets
- [Ayurvedic Pharmacy Software](https://www.ayuplus.in/ayurvedic-pharmacy-software): Ayurvedic medicine inventory, formulary management, and dispensing linked to patient billing
- [Hospital Billing Software](https://www.ayuplus.in/billing): GST-compliant invoices for consultations, Panchakarma sessions, and pharmacy — zero revenue leakage
- [Digital Prescription](https://www.ayuplus.in/digital-prescription): Digital prescription pad for Ayurvedic doctors with classical formulation support
- [Pricing](https://www.ayuplus.in/pricing): Transparent plans — Starter ₹1,499/mo · Professional ₹3,999/mo · Advanced ₹5,999/mo · Enterprise ₹8,999/mo
- [Contact & Demo](https://www.ayuplus.in/contact): Book a free demo or reach Gleaming Software directly

## Key Differentiators vs. Competitors

AyuPlus is the only Ayurvedic HMS with:
- **Vaidya Mode** — dedicated doctor-first EMR for Ayurvedic consultation (no competitor has this)
- **7 Panchakarma forms** built-in — the most comprehensive Panchakarma workflow in any HMS
- **Nadi Pareeksha and Asta Sthana Pariksha** digital records
- **Tithi-based scheduling** — aligns treatment schedules with Ayurvedic almanac (zero competitors)
- **Cloud or on-premises** deployment — all major competitors are cloud-only
- **Transparent published pricing** — all major competitors (Ayurlive, VaidyaManager, EasyClinic) hide their pricing
- **4-language support** — Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, English
